Merge the web-only work (`mngr/hopefully-last-web-details`) into main, which introduces this app. A fixed per-tier OAuth callback redirector deployed as a tiny, secretless Modal Function (`just deploy-oauth-redirector <tier>`): dev/CI tiers register exactly one redirect URI on their shared Google Web client -- this app's URL -- and it forwards the provider callback to the per-env connector callback carried in the OAuth state JWT's `cb` claim, clamped to the tier's connector hostname pattern so it can never act as an open redirector. Keeps one always-warm container so it never adds a cold-boot delay to the Google sign-in path.
